title: Chapter 1097
text:
"I will provide greater support to the Black Star Corps. The services and resources you purchase from the Limitless Financial Group will only be charged at cost price. At the same time, I will bring a large number of preferential business projects to cooperate with the Germinal Financial Group under your banner. On the other hand, I am willing to invest in the construction of factories in the Black Star Corps' territory regardless of the cost. Through burning money, I will support the perfect industrial chain in various fields in your territory … "

Sorokin said a lot. In summary, other than losing money, he would also use the Limitless Financial Group's business and funds to help the Black Star Corps develop and provide many preferential terms.

Han Xiao calculated in his mind. If all these conditions were fulfilled, even with the Limitless Financial Group's huge business, they would still have to pay a huge price. For the army's territory, the construction speed would also increase.

In order to mend their relationship, this guy was not stingy at all.

Sorokin had once used a similar method to help the Bloodshed Land develop. Now, the Bloodshed Land had basically completed its transformation and become a strong competitor of the army in the Shattered Star Ring. At this time, Sorokin was willing to give the same treatment as the Black Star Corps, or even more generous terms.

As for the support from the Tyrant, even if Black Star did not say anything, Sorokin would have temporarily stopped it. Business was business.

"Hmm …" Han Xiao did not deny it and proposed a new condition. "Although the construction of the Flickering World territory is important, the army's goal is even greater. I want to develop in other Star Fields. Your Limitless Financial Group has huge businesses in various Star Fields. You can share this with me."

"… Okay." Sorokin smiled on the surface but was actually gritting his teeth.

He knew that Black Star was not satisfied with the compensation but had his eyes on the Limitless Financial Group's business channels. He wanted to take a share of the profits, suck the Limitless Financial Group's blood, and snatch the Limitless Financial Group's business to nourish the army's business network in other Star Fields.

Although Sorokin was mentally prepared, he still felt the pinch.

He was willing to give so much compensation because, on the one hand, he wanted to mend his relationship with Black Star. Even if the chances of Black Star giving up on dealing with him were only fifty-fifty, it was still worth the investment. On the other hand, he wanted to indirectly express his attitude to the dynasty.

Although this way, the Black Star Corps might become the leeches of the Limitless Financial Group, feasting on the flesh and blood of the Limitless Financial Group, the most important issue at hand was dealing with the dynasty. Bleeding was inevitable. Otherwise, Sorokin would not have compromised like this. Although the Black Star Corps was strong, he wasn't afraid of Han Xiao when it came to business. He was only afraid of the empire behind him.

After this storm, these lost benefits could be slowly reclaimed in the future. The current agreement could also be reneged on. Therefore, Sorokin didn't care about anything else and agreed to it first.

"Also, I like Universal Treasures very much. Whether it's the real thing or the blueprints, I like to collect them. The Limitless Financial Group should have some connections, right? Share some," Han Xiao said slowly.

"I'll try my best to collect some when I get back." Sorokin agreed without hesitation. After all, there was no harm in having too many debts.

"That's all for now. Fulfill these conditions as soon as possible." Han Xiao waved his hand, indicating that he was sending him off. "I still have something to do later, so I won't chat with you anymore."

"Okay, I won't disturb you anymore."

Hearing this, Sorokin stood up, nodded slightly, and ended the communication. The remote projection disappeared instantly.

Han Xiao leaned back, deep in thought.

Traveler is a loyal subject of the Star Arc Civilization. Currently, it seems like only I know about this. I wonder if the dynasty will find out the details in his subsequent trial … Anyway, based on Traveler's statement to the dynasty, he insists that Sorokin is the only scapegoat. The dynasty will definitely send someone to question Sorokin's motives.

At that time, Sorokin would definitely blame the Super Star Cluster Alliance. If I told him that Modo was the mastermind, he would most likely tell the dynasty as well. If the dynasty continued to ask, he would probably say that I told him. The dynasty knew that I was targeting Modo and understood my motives. Even if they knew that this was a lie, they might be happy to see it happen and admit to it. In the future, they would use this as an excuse to find an opportunity to attack the Modo Civilization and the other Super Star Cluster Civilizations.

As for Sorokin, he might not believe my words, but even if he doesn't believe that Traveler is the owner of the Modo Civilization, he will definitely investigate and test it out …

Han Xiao shook his head and chuckled.

This way, the Modo Civilization would be the one to suffer the most in this chain of events.

In the future operations of the three Universal Civilizations to attack the Supercluster Alliance, the Modo Civilization would probably receive a 'warm' welcome from the dynasty.

In that case, the second requirement of the S-grade mission, [Kunde Race Leader's Last Wish], should be more or less completed …

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled, and he rubbed his hands.

He had been eyeing the rewards of this mission for a long time. [Proof of Leadership], [The Enemy], and [Kunde Rage] — a total of three excellent abilities. Currently, the Modo Civilization was under the protection of the Supercluster Alliance, so it was not good for him to fight them head-on. He could only wait for the inevitable conflict to break out in the future.

…

The news of the Blackstar Cup spread like wildfire. The entire army erupted with extremely high enthusiasm, and countless army members signed up.

Most people signed up for entertainment, but a few ambitious army warriors saw that this was an internal selection opportunity and wanted to show their strength.

Among the army players, the Blackstar Cup also caused a huge reaction. The forums welcomed a new round of spam.

Heaven Is Below: What's going on? Not long ago, Black Star was going to enter the entertainment industry, and now the army is going to enter the sports industry?

My Scalp Itches When the Wind Blows: Big factions are so generous (Like)

Even Dead Will Get Shot: I feel that this is more interesting than the Pro League.

Powerless Short: The scale of this event should be the largest so far. There are many events, and there are many participants. Each person is allowed to participate in five events. How many competitions will there be? They can even play cards and gamble!

I Am Your Blessing: Brother Fa is passing by with a loudspeaker (Laughing)

Two Little White Rabbits: Not only cards, but there are also singing and dancing events. I even saw someone apply for a crosstalk competition, which was approved by the higher-ups. (Laughing and crying)

Dragon Emperor Bootlicker: To be honest, I want to see Black Star dance …

Soaring Professional Substitute Training Studio: The rewards for these competitions are quite generous, and the quota is very loose. The most rewards are still the combat-oriented events. The top 300,000 will all be rewarded, and there are no restrictions on the weapons we can use. Speaking of which, if we participate in a group combat competition and use things like Nuclear Bomb Backpacks and Evolution Badges, I'm afraid we can take all the top spots.

President of Fu Ding's Fan Club: Let me take a look, whose wallet is inflating again? (Black Star's Smile.jpg)

Bull Likes It: Army Commander, this is my team fee for this year. (Bow 90 degrees)

The Blackstar Cup was still in preparation, and countless players called their friends and excitedly took out money to prepare for this event.

In the following days, the sales of the logistics department skyrocketed, and Han Xiao's daily experience increased by a large amount. A large number of players learned and leveled up, and more than half of the savings they had accumulated since the start of the Flickering World version were invested in this.

Looking at the daily increase in experience, Han Xiao felt very comfortable.

The players worked so hard to earn this money, so if I don't earn it, am I still human?

At this rate, his level 340 Promotion was just around the corner. However, in order to obtain one more God's Trait Transformation Point during his Promotion, he decided to use this wave of experience to max out some of his blueprints and skills.

Sylvia and Philip were very efficient. With the current status of the Black Star Corps, all administrative procedures were given the green light, and the broadcast media and sponsors were quickly in place.

Han Xiao specially allocated a few barren planets as the competition venue, and the professional galactic engineering team called over by the Limitless Financial Group quickly built the venue. The army members participating in the Blackstar Cup also gathered.

The process was similar to the Pro League. Due to the large number of participants, the qualifiers were used to quickly eliminate a large number of people before slowly holding the competition.

After more than two months of preparation, the preparations for the first Blackstar Cup were finally completed.

On the 28th of October, Year 730 of the Galaxy Calendar, the highly anticipated opening ceremony of the Blackstar Cup was held as scheduled. With the support of the media, the eyes of the entire universe were focused on this event.
